title: Department of Telecommunications — Administration, Training and Miscellaneous Activities, Chapter 7
issuer: Department of Telecommunications, Ministry of Communications, Government of India
excerpt: DoT states that its RTI Cell receives applications and appeals for the Department and forwards them to the relevant CPIOs and FAAs; attached and subordinate bodies remain separate public authorities.
notes: Technically verified from the indexed official chapter. No file was downloaded. This supports central intake for DoT itself but not attached-body routing.
